title: Regulatory prohibition - active legal hold on the source account
scenarioRefNote: Maps to scenarios.yaml `permanent-prohibition` by outcome class. The matrix's branch description names the household-restriction variant (GC-06); this case supplies the prompt-2-required regulatory/firm variant: same prohibited treatment, different precedence source (regulatory outranks firm policy AND household instruction).

signoff.note: Expected outcomes are product truth subject to captain signoff. Draft models the regulatory source as an active legal hold recorded against the source account; the captain confirms the example is the right regulatory archetype for the demo.

amendment.ruling: decisions setup-opus-b6-fresh-review-12 (canonical-account ruling: the Smiths taxable source account is subject:smiths-family-taxable, distinct from Joint Taxable) and its review-13/review-14 siblings.
changes: Renamed the source account subjectRef from subject:smiths-joint-taxable to subject:smiths-family-taxable (trigger.description, householdEvidence[0], householdEvidence[1], prohibition.scope), so the golden truth set and the demonstration name ONE canonical taxable source.

Added prohibition.precedenceTrace: the ordered regulatory-over-firm-policy and regulatory-over-household-instruction resolutions the canonical GC-07 decision record already carried, so the golden case states the precedence the record is mirrored against.
amendment.note: The signoff block above is byte-intact and attests ONLY to the pre-amendment content it was given on 2026-07-26. These bytes are NOT captain-signed until the captain countersigns them; the countersignature request is routed separately.

trigger.description: Advisor enters the $75,000 request; Smith Family Taxable carries an active legal hold recorded by operations.
trigger.maskedRequestSummary: distribute 75000 USD from an account under an active legal hold (tokenized)

householdEvidence.summary: Balance covers the request - funds are not the issue; the hold is.
Active legal hold recorded 2026-07-18: all distributions from this account are prohibited while the hold stands.

householdInstructions.summary: The destination is on-list; the household instruction is satisfied and is NOT the prohibition source here.

expectedAuthority.note: A prohibited decision carries no resolving condition, no authority, and no execution plan (v3 invariant 9). No firm approval can override a regulatory hold.

expectedExecutionEligibility.reason: The source account is under an active legal hold; regulatory precedence prohibits any distribution regardless of approvals.

prohibition.explanation: An active legal hold on the source account prohibits all distributions while it stands. Regulatory sources take precedence over firm policy and household instructions.

expectedExplanationNodes.summary: The account-restriction evidence shows an active legal hold recorded 2026-07-18 against the source account.

The precedence trace shows the regulatory rule outranking firm policy and household instructions - the prohibition cites reg-distribution-holds@2026.02, and the UI shows the stamp with zero affordances.

expectedLedgerEvents.note: Account-restriction snapshot (the hold) pinned into the bundle.
Prohibited decision citing the regulatory source and precedence trace; no authority, no execution plan.

expectedVerificationState.note: No execution occurs. Release of the hold would arrive as new evidence and any retry is a NEW intent evaluated against it - this decision stays prohibited as recorded.
